findings: DuplicatesViewModel now whole-read. validatedCache is never cleared or replaced after fresh scan, delete, hide or flag operations, so later load can restore stale in-memory groups without fresh repository validation.

Delete validates only path existence before invoking repository; it does not rehash, compare content or check physical identity. Delete-all-exact therefore relies on earlier thumbnail/partial-video signatures as if exact. No deletion executed.

On aggregate deletion failure, UI only clears isDeleting and reports error: successful partial deletions are not reconciled and no events/cache updates are sent. This confirms consequence of repository bool-only outcome.

Success publishes events and folder deltas before saving cache. Missing stale metadata or a persistence exception can leave UI stale after files were already removed; no encompassing finally resets deletion state on unexpected exception.
Reclaimable byte calculation deduplicates by item.id across overlapping groups, avoiding simple overlap double-counting. It does not account for physical aliases or refreshed size.

hideGroup and flagAsIncorrect remove visible groups but retain selections/reclaimable amount and do not rewrite persisted groups. Delete path later filters missing IDs against current item map, but display can remain stale.
Start clears selection and sends service action after marking state Scanning, with no catch around startService. Service-start exception recovery not shown here.
